accepted.evidence: Full CDIAL nasta subsection 1 explicitly gives Torwali natkōl nose and Maiyan nathūr nose. Torwali netkel and Mai nasūr/nāsūr are provisionally grouped with those exact regional comparisons, preserving source vowels and s versus th notation. Turner marks the extension of natkōl and related forms with uncertainty; no independent origin of the whole extension or component segmentation is asserted. Regional transmission remains unresolved. This uses the nose-bearing branch, not the separate nastā nose-ring branch. Exact response: netkel.
